name: Artemtek Image to ASCII
description: Converts images to ASCII art text files. Processes all images in the input directory.

inputs.name: Input Directory
inputs.description: Directory containing images to convert (PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WEBP).

inputs.name: Width
inputs.description: Width of ASCII art in characters (default: 100, range: 10-500).

outputs.name: Output Directory
outputs.description: Directory where ASCII art text files will be saved (one .txt file per image).
